intro: External factors, ethics and success (1.7, 1.8): the big ideas, key words and examples on one sheet. Keep it in your book and use it to revise (cover, write, check).

panels.title: Big questions
points: The UK population is getting older. Which businesses win and which lose?
If a robot can pack boxes faster and cheaper than people, should a business always use the robot?
Should a business pay for the pollution it causes, even when the law does not require it?
A new law raises the minimum wage. Is that good or bad for business?

panels.title: Islamic foundation
panels.text: Islam teaches care for elders: Allah commands kindness to parents, especially in old age (Al-Isra' 17:23 to 24). Businesses serving an ageing population can meet real needs ethically.

panels.title: Explain how working from home affects a city-centre café (3 marks)
points: Point: fewer office workers in the city
Development: fewer weekday customers buying coffee and lunch
Consequence: lower revenue unless it adapts (delivery, residential area)
Answer: A 3-mark explain answer with point, development and consequence

panels.title: Analyse one benefit of automation for a bakery (6 marks)
points: Point: lower labour cost per loaf
Development: machines run long hours consistently
Development: productivity rises
Consequence: lower unit cost lets it cut prices or raise margins
Answer: A developed 6-mark analyse answer

panels.title: Write a purpose and USP for 'Green Lunchbox'
points: Purpose: healthy halal lunches with zero plastic
Target market: busy parents in the local area
USP: reusable boxes collected and washed
Evidence: social trend (green consumers)
Answer: A clear purpose, market and USP

panels.title: A café sells £60,000; the town's café market is £400,000. Market share?
points: Answer: 15%
